Definition: from G2300; a place for public show ("theatre"), i.e. general audience-room; by implication, a show itself (figuratively):--spectacle, theatre.
BiblicalUsage: théatron is the word for a theatre, a public spectacle. In Acts 19:29, they rushed with one accord into the theatre, and it appears again in 1 Corinthians 4:9.
TheologicalSignificance: Apostles set out like men sentenced to die in the arena tells me following Christ was never meant to be a comfortable seat in the crowd.
